fingerprint.profile: release; thin LTO; codegen-units=1 for measured crates

method.comparison: Identical benchmark fixtures, lockfile, toolchain and content on the same machine; one timing process at a time after compilation completed.
method.criterion_statistic: Median of sample time / iterations, pooled across both trials per variant. This is not the Criterion regression-slope point estimate. Raw iterations, elapsed samples and bootstrap estimates are retained.
method.gpu_delta: Baseline plus candidate crates/clonk-app-render/src/gpu_renderer.rs, with identical landscape_render benchmark in both. No frontend or VM production change is needed by this fixture.
method.gpu_wall_time_scope: Plan clone, CPU encoding, queue submit and device.poll for a completed offscreen frame; timestamp instrumentation disabled on this device.
method.gpu_timestamp_scope: Separate timestamp-enabled device; ShaderLandscape pass only, 4 warm frames then 32 consecutive samples per workload/trial. Frame identity and sample validity asserted. These short windows show GPU clock variation and are diagnostic, not a whole-frame timing claim.
method.scenario_statistic: Median of 10 fresh-run window mean tick times per variant/scenario, clock-disabled rows only; every timed and untimed window retained.
method.scenario_scope: Headless simulation ticks excluding scenario loading and snapshots. Invocation counters enabled in both variants, VM elapsed clocks disabled for headline comparison. Native hosts remain included; this does not measure shipped whole-game FPS.
method.excluded_probes: Earlier scenarios collected before final fallback-diagnostic classification cleanup and initial measurements overlapping builds are not included in these final scenario estimates.
method.limitations: One Apple Silicon machine, two reversed trials, synthetic renderer fixtures, and two fixed-seed scenarios. Small differences are not universal improvements; report controls and slower cases too. No full-scenario C++ differential validation is claimed.
